A1.title: Discovery
A1.objective: Understand and use familiar everyday expressions. Introduce oneself and ask simple questions.

A2.title: Survival
A2.objective: Understand frequently used expressions. Communicate during simple tasks. Describe one's environment.

B1.title: Threshold
B1.objective: Get by in most travel situations. Talk about things, express a wish, give reasons.

B2.title: Advanced
B2.objective: Understand the main content of concrete or abstract topics. Express oneself clearly and in detail.

C1.title: Proficient User
C1.objective: Understand long and demanding texts. Express oneself spontaneously and fluently. Use the language flexibly and effectively.

C2.title: Mastery
C2.objective: Effortlessly understand almost everything. Express yourself spontaneously, very fluently, and precisely.

C1.5.title: Towards Excellence
C1.5.theme: Subtleties, DALF C1, varieties of French

C2.2.title: Creation and Personal Expression
C2.2.theme: Poetry, short story, theater, expert summary
